data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 18.633m. Using the gross claims development table the syndicate shows net favourable development on prior years (2019-2021) totalling approximately GBP 1.827m (a c.9.8% release of opening reserves). The syndicate is monoline Medical Malpractice (Professional Lines), and the release reflects favourable claims development on older underwriting years.
